comparison: same 27 calibrations and frozen seed-20260913 sample of 24 linear swipes as v1

method.frame_score: mean RGB brightness in centre minus mean RGB brightness in surrounding ring
method.confirmation_rule: median local contrast after candidate minus median before candidate >= 6.0
method.reported_frame: candidate frame; look-ahead frames only confirm it

remaining_errors: Two calibration searches return no result because the old search windows omit the onset transition.
One old calibration is selected one frame after the human label because its onset is the first searchable frame.
One swipe is selected ten frames early when a moving red floor graphic produces sustained local brightening.
interpretation: V2 improves this retrospective development set, especially sampled swipes, but the sample and thresholds are not independent validation.
